messages.subject: Re: How to fix error: Package choroplethrMaps is needed for this function to work. Please install it.
parts:
It looks like you are using choroplethr, which only suggests choroplethrMaps.
If you are actually making use of it, you have to let shinyapps.io know by adding library(choroplethrMaps)
